title: Seismic Events at Mount Vesuvius
hook: The dataset this week explores seismic events detected at the famous Mount Vesuvius in Italy. It comes from the Italian Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia (INGV)'s Data Portal and can be explored along with other seismic areas on the GOSSIP website. The raw data was saved as individual CSV files from the GOSSIP website and some values were translated from Italian to English. The Open Data Portal of Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia (INGV) gives public access to data resulting from institutional research activities in the fields of Seismology, Volcanology, and Environment.
